comment: Lush green garden, spacious restaurant, delicious food will make your experience unforgettable. Good option for lunch and caters to big groups with ease.
Ambience and cleanliness was very good. Food top notch. Special mention to Mr. Karan who was the server.
A truly delightful dining experience. The ambiance is charming, with lovely lighting and comfortable seating.
